title: Sum Even Numbers
description: Given a list of integers, return the sum of all even integers in the list.
hints: Check whether each number is divisible by 2.
io_contract: sum_even(numbers) returns the arithmetic sum of every integer in numbers that is divisible by 2. Negative even integers are included. An empty list returns 0.
ambiguity_resolutions: Zero is an even integer and is included in the sum.
An empty list returns 0, not an error or null.
The input order does not affect the result.
